units.source_text: 我们让那女子先行，我搀扶着柏木随后，刚要钻进那幢西班牙式洋房的旁门，一阵恐怖感袭上了我的心头。

en.t: We let the woman go on ahead, and I followed after her while supporting Kashiwagi; just as we were about to slip through the side door of that Spanish-style Western house, a feeling of terror came over me.

units.source_text: 我扔下了柏木，连头也不回就逃回来了。

en.t: I abandoned Kashiwagi and fled back without even turning my head.

units.source_text: 连顺道回学校的时间也没有，径直在幽静的人行道上奔跑而去。

en.t: There was not even time to stop by the school on the way; I simply ran straight off along the quiet sidewalk.

units.source_text: 沿途经过药铺、点心铺、电器行等店铺。

en.t: Along the way I passed shops such as a pharmacy, a confectionery, and an electrical goods store.

units.source_text: 这时在我的眼前闪烁着紫色和红色，我想多半是我打天理教弘德分教会的前面跑过去时，

en.t: At that moment purple and red flickered before my eyes; I suppose it was probably because, as I ran past the front of the Tenrikyo Kotoku branch church,

units.source_text: 看到了黑土墙挂着成排绘有梅花家微的灯笠门口目卜了缓步同样的梅花家徽的紫色帷幔的缘故吧。

en.t: I had seen rows of lanterns painted with the plum-blossom crest hanging on the black earthen wall, and a purple curtain bearing the same plum-blossom crest hanging at the gate.
